comparison.objective: Read a compass card and place a cube on the pad north of a plate; candidate removes and contains insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Compass task tests spatial-symbol interpretation and simple placement; candidate tests precision bimanual tooling, force control, and small-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Cube center must be within the correct pad and no more than 2 cm above its support; any other location scores zero. Candidate requires four damage-free fractures and four physically deposited fragments.
comparison.reason: Directional reasoning plus placement does not test impact fracture or insert retention.
